in_sanskrit.name: प्रतीक्षा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The act of waiting or expecting something to happen. The feeling of hope or anticipation. The divine power of perception or intuition.

in_telugu.name: ప్రతీక్షా
in_telugu.long_meaning: Ashada (hope, expectation), Adhisha (lord, master), Adhidesha (control, governance).

in_marathi.name: Prateeksha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Prateeksha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The longing for something to be fulfilled, a deep yearning for a wish to come true.

vedic_reference.note: Prateeksha is a goddess in Hindu mythology, the goddess of perception or intuition. She is also known as the goddess of hope and expectation. She is often depicted with lotus flowers and is said to grant the boon of perception and insight to those who seek her.
